data.text:
**scale proof**
International POS with sites in US, UK, Sweden, France, Germany, Nordics, Mexico, Brazil, Spain, Italy per zettle.com.
**problem mechanism**
Uncertain: site implies merchants stitch sales, inventory, staff, e-commerce/accounting together, but no failure mechanism evidenced.
**cost evidence**
Only fee evidence found: GB 1.75% card/QR, 2.5% invoice/payment links; hardware £29–£169; no problem-cost quantified — uncertain.
**counter-evidence**
Site claims free POS app, no contracts, funds in minutes, integrated e-commerce/accounting hub.
**wedge fit**
Uncertain/weak: no single evidenced costly data problem found to offer free fix.
**verdict (worth 3-6k/month: yes or no)**
No.
**why**
Scale is real but no mechanism-or-cost evidence from zettle.com to justify $3–6k/mo; needs deeper research.
